chained_from: proj_fully_fused (a byte-identical copy of the means2d/radii/depths/conics fwd goldens, seed 7) — the same chaining convention as isect_std
golden_source: C++ CPU reference isect_tiles_cpu (AccuTile) — splatx-core-tests --dump-accutile. Reimplementation of gsplat@77ab983:IntersectTile.cu:83-207,288-372
key_encoding: isect_id(u64) = image_id << (32+tile_n_bits) | tile_id << 32 | f32bits(depth); tile_id = tile_y*tile_width + tile_x; SXT does not support int64 → stored split into lo/hi int32 (D3).
note: The golden producer = the CPU reference — no torch cross-check is possible (torch _isect_tiles has no AccuTile, 07 Correction 2). Defenses against the self-confirmation risk of generating and verifying the golden with the same code: (a) the AccuTile ⊆ AABB assertion (per-element tile count ≤ plus (flatten,key) pair subset — AABB is the baseline already checked against the torch golden in isect_std), (b) an independent geometric oracle (the box minimum of a convex quadratic form) and symmetry property tests (IsectTests isect_tiles_accutile_properties). Measured AccuTile reduction rate: n_isects 3506 vs AABB 5097 (31.2% reduction). opacities is LCG-synthesized (seed 0x5EEDACC0) over [0.02,0.99) plus 2 special slots (t_zero_idx: opacity==the exact α_thresh value → t=0, t_neg_idx: 0.001 < α_thresh → t<0 — covers the approved deviation of disposition #13). Emit order: element idx → sweep axis u → orthogonal axis v (the isY swap frame). All tensors are compared exact (int/bit).
